basis: JSNode fabrication package test plan and module projection. The plan selects only the owning package's tests and preserves declared requirements. A projected catalog is a declaration executed by the existing Node.js interpreter.

cases.claim: A test requirement declaration must identify a test owned by the package and name a valid requirement.
cases.test: a declaration must name a test of the package and real requirements

cases.claim: A module specification deterministically produces a shared module and a native NDJSON catalog without wrappers.
cases.test: projects shared source modules and one schema-bound NDJSON catalog without wrappers

cases.claim: The original runner preserves inherited and command-line reporter bindings, implicit stdout and unrelated runtime options while adding its private receiver.
cases.test: native reporter bindings survive the original runner with inherited runtime options

cases.claim: Adding a private receiver cannot turn invalid original reporter and destination cardinality into a successful test run.
cases.test: a private receiver cannot repair invalid original reporter cardinality

cases.claim: An installed consumer receives a test plan that omits fixtures and child-package tests while retaining test requirements.
